2609.12156.title: A decision-basis contract for auditable LLM-assisted medical billing verification: deterministic rules, verbatim evidence, and fail-closed abstention
2609.12156.paper_summary: This work presents a proof of concept for auditable LLM-assisted medical billing verification based on a decision-basis contract. The contract separates deterministic checks of versioned fee-catalog rules from LLM-based assessment of free-text documentation. The deterministic layer resolves the applicable catalog release and checks code availability, quantity limits, and exclusions. The semantic layer classifies each claimed item as supported, contradicted, or missing required information. Support and contradiction require a verbatim evidence span; unavailable rule context, unsuccessful assessment, or missing required evidence prevents support through fail-closed abstention. We evaluated four locally run open-weight models on a synthetic catalog and 36 curated cases under the contract, an ablation without explicit documentation requirements, and an end-to-end baseline. Outcome agreement varied across models and showed no consistent advantage over the baseline. Explicit documentation requirements improved identification of missing information for all four models. The evidence gate also exposed cases in which correct raw judgments lacked valid evidence and were converted to incomplete decision-basis entries. The results show how explicit decision records can make rule findings, documentation judgments, and abstention reasons inspectable. Evaluation on real catalogs, independently annotated documentation, and with human reviewers is required to assess practical value.
2609.12156.paper_summary_zh: 這項工作展示了一個基於決策基礎合約的可審計 LLM 協助醫療計費驗證的概念證明。合約將版本化費用目錄規則的確定性檢查與基於 LLM 的自由文本文件評估分開。確定性層解決適用的目錄版本並檢查代碼可用性、數量限制和排除項。語義層將每個索賠項目分類為支持、矛盾或缺少所需信息。支持和矛盾需要逐字證據範圍；不可用的規則上下文、評估失敗或缺少所需證據會通過失效閉合的放棄來阻止支持。我們在合約下對一個合成目錄和 36 個策劃案例評估了四個本地運行的開放權重模型，進行了一次不帶明確文件要求的消融實驗，以及一個端到端基準。結果一致性在模型之間有所不同，並未顯示出對基準的持續優勢。明確的文件要求提高了所有四個模型對缺失信息的識別。證據閘還揭示了正確的原始判斷缺乏有效證據的情況，並被轉換為不完整的決策基礎條目。結果顯示，明確的決策記錄如何使規則發現、文件判斷和放棄理由可檢查。需要在真實目錄上、獨立註釋的文件和人類審查者的參與下進行評估，以評估實際價值。
